★Request
Buena Vista accelerating spiritedly, radiating the aura of a promising competitor

Wait, that's Buena-chan's childhood friend?! No way, where, where?!
Like, did you sign a contract already?! You did?! That's so emooo-tional!!
......Wait, for real? "Provisional"?! What's that even meeean?!?!?
Right then, however, a massive cheer erupted from the track—
We're still under a provisional contract, you see.

My! She's got quite the late burst of speed, doesn't she...!
If she's already this good... hehe, with a little polish, she's sure to shine!
What a surprise. I mean, I heard today was her first day—

A few days after the incident before the Three Goddesses statue.
At a fan event held at Tokyo Racecourse, an exhibition race took place—

To reach the goal during our provisional contract that you mentioned before—
victory in the Event-by-Event Sports Festival.

While Vodka-chan is a Tiara girl, she also conquered the
Nippon Derby, which is said to be the dream of every Umamusume.
! ......You knew?

That's why I'll choose the Trainer who is truly right for me.
That's my plan.

Hehe, that's good to hear.
...Well then, do you think we can start training in earnest tomorrow?

Because I wanted to catch up. Because I wanted to stand by her side.
Not just because "we're childhood friends"—

The gap is driven home with vivid intensity. Hammered into me relentlessly.
Come to think of it—it was just like this back then, too.

Hah, so this is what the competition looks like, huh...
This bet's turnin' out to have pretty bad odds...!

And after all that—I had bowed my head to her the other day,
asking her to judge for herself whether we should form a full contract.

...We'll really have to give it our all.
After all, we're up against an insanely tough lineup—

Rumor had it this exhibition had quite the talented field, but...
Buena Vista is clearly a cut above the rest, after all!!

And so, she left me far behind in the blink of an eye.
...Yet, even then, I just couldn't give up.
Nggghhh...! That's, like, craaazy...!!
Surrounded by thunderous cheers—I clench my fists tightly, all alone.

Before long, she began running faster and faster, dashing off beyond the horizon.
Unlike me—she was an Umamusume born to run.

Hehe, yep, that's the one!
And right now—

Leaving me in the dust long ago, when it was uncertain if I could even become a Trainer...
she had already begun to shine as a runner full of promise.

...The time I could actually hold her hand and guide her
was only for a brief moment when she was very small.

There's a shiny new rookie out there.
Is that her? The one everyone's talkin' about?

Whoa, I'm sorry! I ran too much ahead...
I need to slow down, I'm sorry.

Before I knew it—I was standing in front of the academy gates I had long admired.
Deeply ashamed of my own naivety, my eyes still searched for her silhouette.

—That's right. I definitely want to reach that breathtaking view,
just like the one Spe-san showed us someday.

Ever since the day I watched her through the fence. Ever since the day I ran home gritting my teeth,
I studied relentlessly. I threw myself into learning with absolute desperation.

Back then, my days at the training institute—which I got into after studying frantically—
were far harsher and tougher than I imagined, leaving me constantly struggling.

Haah, haah...!
Haaaaahhh!!

...Hoping we could encourage each other was out of the question.
Seeing her from afar outside the fence, she had already become a flower far beyond my reach.

Oops, it's about that time...! I have to get ready for the race!
Well then, Nakayama-san, Jordan-san, please excuse me.

...Well then!
I'm counting on you starting tomorrow, Provisional Trainer!

—And now, the exhibition race is entering the final stretch! With 400 meters to go,
here comes Buena Vista on the outside! Buena Vista with a razor-sharp charge!

—Across the line! In first place is Buena Vista!! It's Buena Vista!!
She has truly stolen the show, lighting up this exhibition with a magnificent victory!!

Judge for myself... wait, me? Judge you?
But—

Hehe, ahaha!! Over here, over here!!
Let's go, Big Sis—... Huh?

Haah, whew... Big sis, where are you...?
Don't leave Bu-chan behind...!!

Haah, whew... Big bro, where are you...?
Don't leave Bu-chan behind...!!

The ones drawing the most attention are Scarlet-chan, winner of the
Oka Sho and Shuka Sho, crowned as a Double Tiara champion—

Hehe, ahaha!! Over here, over here!!
Let's go, Big Bro—... Huh?

Though she has yet to make her debut, that was a breathtaking run that promises great things to come,
Buena Vista! The crowd responds with a generous round of applause!

Against two runners representing this era,
you're going to help me win before my debut. ...Right?

...Oh? Hey.
Over there where all those Trainers are swarming—

Ah, found you...! Hehe, I'm glad I got to see you.
You came to watch the exhibition, right?
